note: Items and synonyms (English, Devanagari Hindi, Hinglish spellings and common misspellings) were AI-generated and then reviewed by a human; spot-check before relying on a term. Bump version when the list changes. extraCategories lists the other kinds of shop that really carry an item (fevicol: hardware, and stationery too); the shops pinged for an item are those of any of its categories. Loaded by npm run seed:catalog. refPricePaise is the typical shelf price in paise of the usual pack an Indian shopper asks for; it is AI-estimated (not surveyed), so treat it as a plausible reference, not a quote. Used by the shop simulator and, later, the rupees-saved metric. defaultFor lists generic words that mean this item as the usual choice of a family (pen: ball pen); a word that could be several different things (clip, oil, battery) is never a default. ambiguous lists everyday words that mean several items (mirchi, daal, tel): the customer is asked which one, with these main options, instead of being given a guess.
